description: Get a pepvault.app reference page by its path or URL (for example /guides/where-to-inject-peptides), as its published Markdown. It reads the reference pages listed on pepvault.app, not the pages about the PepVault app.

max_chars.description: Return at most this many characters of the page (2000–30000; default the whole page up to 30000).

name: get_page
title: Get a PepVault page
